notes.title: How to fix "unknown event with id ..."
notes.notes:
After updating you might encounter this bug when trying to load your save file:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41561449/cf227642512777092f26045288c34bbd229da277.png[/img]

[u]Here's what to do:[/u]
Start a new game and simply press G until you can control Solvac.
Then press DEL and load your desired save file. This probably won't work the first time you try it. Just repeat the loading until your loaded file looks normal again.

notes.title: 0.9.5.2 language upgrade
notes.notes:
fixes, improvements:
- the mod Block (Chloe) does not only prevent phy. attacks, it also prevents the combo status by 100%
- the dynasty beetles have been reduced a little in their difficulty
- Vincent got a bit more Attack Power and the enemies in Moralless are a bit slower
- Multi-Potions are actually being reduced in number, when you use them ^^
- Vincents Potiontolerance is being reset now after battle
- Chloes Auto-Defense should work properly now and has 2 new upgrades
- the game shouldn't crash anymore towards the end

unsolved bugs:
- in Satori Cave a ghost fight with no enemy might occur ... in that case possibly look at the value of variable 78 and tell me
- skillnames in battle are not being shown translated (bottom of the screen when skill is being used)
